items.name: Bladed Levitation
items.text: The Scourge has a fly speed of 30 feet, but must end its turn within no more than 5 feet off the ground, otherwise it falls and takes damage as normal

items.name: Final Execution
items.text: The scourge targets a Paralyzed creature with a blade melee Strike. A successful hit is automatically a critical hit and the target creature must succeed at a DC 36 Fortitude save or become Doomed 1. If the target is already doomed, they instead increased their doomed value by 1.

items.name: Life Sap
items.text: A creature damaged by the Scourge's blade Strikes must succeed at a DC 36 Fortitude save save or become Drained 1; if the target is already drained, they instead increased their drained value by 1, to a maximum of Drained 3. On a critical failure, the target is also Paralyzed until the end of the Scourge's next turn.

items.name: To Shreds
items.text:
The Scourge explodes into a whirling tornado of metal and blades, at the cost of briefly leaving its warshard core vulnerable. All creatures within a 20-foot emanation must succeed at a DC 33 Reflex save save or take 10d10 slashing,3d8 void damage. The Scourge can't use To Shreds for 1d4 rounds.

If the Scourge is targeted by a Reactive Strike as a result of using this action, it takes a –2 circumstance penalty to its AC; if the Reactive Strike disrupts this action, this penalty remains until the start of the Scourge's next turn.

Effect: To Shreds (AC Penalty)
